title.zh-TW: 沒用過 Pro 的朋友，註冊可得 7 天 Pro
title.en: 7 days of Pro for friends who have not used Pro

text.zh-TW: 用邀請碼 VN553YCF 註冊並兌換；限沒用過 Pro 的朋友。取自平台分享文案與邀請頁；實際內容以官方公告為準。
text.en: Register and redeem with code VN553YCF; for people who have never used Pro. From the share text and invite page; official terms prevail.

steps.zh-TW: 點擊「立即註冊」開啟邀請連結（網址含邀請碼 VN553YCF；開啟後網址列會移除這個參數，是否自動套用不明）。
steps.en: Select “Sign up” to open the invite link (the address contains code VN553YCF; the address bar drops it after loading, so automatic use is unclear).

steps.zh-TW: 用 Google 帳號登入（依平台說明頁，網站目前只支援 Google 登入；在 LINE 等 App 內建瀏覽器可能失敗，請改用 Safari 或 Chrome）。
steps.en: Log in with Google (per the help page, the website supports only Google login; it may fail in in-app browsers such as LINE, so use Safari or Chrome).

steps.zh-TW: 到「輸入邀請碼」畫面，輸入 VN553YCF（依原樣，含大小寫）兌換 7 天 Pro；若已帶入，請確認相同。
steps.en: On the “enter invite code” screen, type VN553YCF exactly as shown, including capitalization, to redeem 7 days of Pro; if it is filled in, check it matches.

intro.zh-TW: 用邀請碼 VN553YCF 註冊 Tide 潮汐（台股資金流向資訊），沒用過 Pro 的朋友可得 7 天 Pro。
intro.en: Sign up for Tide, a Taiwan stock-data service, with code VN553YCF; friends new to Pro get 7 days of Pro.

description.zh-TW: Tide 潮汐是台灣的台股資訊服務，有網站與手機 App，收盤後整理三大法人買賣超與各類股的資金流向，分為免費與付費的 Pro 方案。本頁連結已含邀請碼 VN553YCF；依平台邀請頁，沒用過 Pro 的朋友用邀請碼註冊，可得 7 天 Pro。實際內容以 Tide 官方公告為準。
description.en: Tide (潮汐) is a Taiwan stock-information service with a website and mobile apps. After each market close it summarizes institutional investor buy and sell data from the TWSE and TPEx as sector fund-flow charts and rankings, with a free tier and a paid Pro plan. The link on this page already contains invite code VN553YCF. According to the platform's invite page, a friend who has never used Pro gets 7 days of Pro after registering with the code. Actual terms follow Tide's official announcements.

notes.zh-TW: 維運者 2026-10-24 用瀏覽器開過連結；註冊時邀請碼是否被接受，沒有測試。兌換需先登入，依平台說明頁，網站目前只支援 Google 登入；平台可能隨時調整或終止邀請規則。Tide 是市場資訊整理工具，網站聲明非證券投資顧問事業，內容不構成投資建議。營運者說法不一：服務條款寫個人經營者，頁尾署名潮汐資訊有限公司，本站未能查證公司登記。隱私權政策要求未滿 18 歲者先由法定代理人閱讀並同意。
notes.en: The maintainer opened the link in a browser on 2026-10-24; whether the code is accepted at sign-up was not tested. Redeeming needs a login, and per the platform's help page the website currently supports Google login only; Tide may change or end its invite rules at any time. Tide is a market-information tool; its own terms say it is not a securities investment advisory business and its content is not investment advice. The operator is described inconsistently: the terms name an individual operator while the footer names 潮汐資訊有限公司, and this site could not verify a company registration. The privacy policy asks users under 18 to have a legal guardian read and agree to it first.

q.zh-TW: 誰可以拿到 7 天 Pro？
q.en: Who can get the 7 days of Pro?

a.zh-TW: 依邀請頁，沒用過 Pro 的朋友用邀請人的邀請碼註冊，可得 7 天 Pro。分享文案沒有提到「沒用過 Pro」這個條件，實際以兌換畫面與官方公告為準。
a.en: Per the invite page, a friend who has never used Pro and registers with the inviter's code gets 7 days of Pro. The share text does not mention the never-used-Pro condition; the redeem screen and official announcements prevail.

q.zh-TW: 7 天 Pro 到期會自動扣款嗎？
q.en: Is there an automatic charge when the 7 days end?

a.zh-TW: 依平台說明頁，邀請碼的試用不需綁定付款方式，到期自動回到免費版，不會扣款。實際規則以 Tide 官方公告為準。
a.en: Per the platform's help page, the invite-code trial has no payment method attached and returns to the free tier when it ends, without a charge. Tide's official announcements prevail.
